_about: hc-1091 多助手二期 R6: the relay plan (一条龙接力) block, protocol apex-plan/1. Desktop's own marker (not apex-next/1): the engine writes it only in Desktop chat sessions with relay on (apex_overlay/handoff.py PLAN_RULE), Desktop reads it (apps/desktop/src/lib/handoff-plan.ts) and draws the plan card.
prompt_template: the block exactly as PLAN_RULE prints it (tests/apex_overlay/test_handoff_plan_cases.py asserts it is in the rule; the Desktop test parses it to prompt_template_legs).
cases: text -> legs (null: no plan), over_cap, visible (the text without plan blocks). Read by apps/desktop/src/lib/handoff-plan.test.ts.
max_legs: batons in one plan, 「已有」 counted (L3); both sides read it.
